title: The Picnic Blanket
story:
On a warm Saturday, Jules and Sam carried a picnic to the wide park by the canal. They chose a spot under a tree where the shade was cool. Jules shook the blanket and spread it on the grass. A few dry leaves sat in the middle, so Sam brushed them away. They put the basket on one corner so the blanket would not fly up.

Inside the basket there were sandwiches, apples, and a flask of cold tea. Sam poured the tea into two cups and passed one to Jules. They ate slowly and watched boats move along the canal. When crumbs fell, two ants appeared at the edge of the blanket. Sam moved the apples to a plate and covered them with a napkin. Jules shook the crumbs farther onto the grass.

She did not want insects in the food, but she did not want to hurt them either. The ants followed the crumbs and left the blanket alone. After lunch they lay back and looked at the leaves. The shade shifted, so they moved the blanket once. Later a breeze grew stronger, and the cups tipped. Sam caught his cup, but a little tea spilled on his shoe. They laughed and packed everything before the clouds thickened. On the walk home, Jules said the quiet meal had been the best part of the day. Sam agreed and asked to do it again next weekend.
